safety.v117_policy: Feature code is materialized with git show and copied only to /tmp on source host/container. Focused tests run before live corpus reads. GamerAccounting and Business Central are read-only. No Mongo writes occur. Evidence snapshots are temp-only under /tmp and are not runtime authority. /app is unchanged. No restart, SharePoint move/upload, Mongo mutation, BC write, or Production routing authority is permitted.

next_after_success: If V117 reaches zero wrong automatic routes, 100% automatic accuracy, and at least 90% heldout coverage, integrate the learned AP router shadow-first in UAT while the deterministic route remains authoritative and accumulate real intake telemetry. Production remains untouched until explicit authorization.
notes: V117 REV2 is now a valid measured failure, not a transport-only attempt: 56 holdouts, 19 auto-routes, 37 reviews, 33.93% coverage, 78.95% auto-route accuracy, and four wrong auto-routes. All 137 targeted expansion documents hydrated successfully and the merged evidence set reached 298 labels. The four unsafe cases exposed one authority defect: an allowed contract route or verified BC order was still enough to authorize unsupported specialization. REV3 feature 5aaa52cac87e6c4087b5007bb98594ca868b6d7a adds fail-closed dynamic-child, static-child, and Rhonda-Issues authority boundaries while preserving the existing Evergreen Tooling veto. Six focused regression/positive-control cases were added beside the existing eight; the controller now requires both files before any live corpus read. Promotion thresholds remain unchanged.
